report.advertisedClaim: Delta advertises no change fees for tickets originating in the U.S. and Canada to anywhere in the world for Delta Classic and Extra experiences. However, for cancellations, non-refundable tickets (such as Main Cabin/Classic) are not eligible for a cash refund after 24 hours; instead, you receive an eCredit.
report.policyFinding: If you cancel a non-refundable Main Cabin (Classic) ticket after the 24-hour risk-free period, you do not get your money back to your original form of payment. Instead, you receive an eCredit for the remaining value of your ticket, which can be used for future travel. Only refundable tickets are eligible for a full refund after the 24-hour period.
report.explanation: Delta's 'no change fees' policy applies to changing your flight, not to refunds for cancellations. For Main Cabin (Classic) tickets, which are non-refundable, canceling after the 24-hour risk-free window results in an eCredit, not a cash refund. The only way to get your money back is to cancel within 24 hours of purchase or to have purchased a refundable ticket.
importantConditions: Main Cabin (Classic) tickets are non-refundable after 24 hours from purchase.
Cancel within 24 hours of purchase for a full refund to original payment method.
After 24 hours, cancellation results in an eCredit, not a cash refund.
You must cancel before departure; otherwise, the ticket has no value.
Refundable tickets are eligible for a full refund after cancellation.

evidence.excerpt: If you purchased a non-refundable ticket such as Basic or Classic Travel Experience, you may cancel your ticket [prior to departure](https://www.delta.com/us/en/change-cancel/cancel-flight#noshowpolicy) and receive an eCredit, minus any applicable fees. The remaining value of your ticket after applicable fees are deducted will be issued as an eCredit.

If your plans change and you booked a non-refundable ticket, you can cancel your ticket for an eCredit minus any applicable [cancellation fees](https://www.delta.com/us/en/baggage/overview#changecancelfees). Classic and Basic tickets are nonrefundable. Please be sure to cancel your flight prior to departure. Non-refundable tickets not changed or canceled prior to departure will have no remaining value.
Most tickets are non-refundable, and an eCredit will be issued instead of a refund back to your original form of payment if you cancel a non-refundable ticket.

As part of our [Customer Commitment](https://www.delta.com/us/en/legal/customer-commitment) for customers who book direct on delta.com or the Fly Delta app, Risk-Free Cancellation means that after you’ve purchased a qualifying eTicket, you have up to 24 hours after booking to cancel it for any reason and receive a full refund with no fees.

unansweredQuestions: Are there any exceptions for Main Cabin tickets (e.g., medical emergencies, schedule changes) that would allow a cash refund?
What is the exact expiration policy for eCredits issued for canceled Main Cabin tickets?
nextSteps: If you are within 24 hours of purchase, cancel now to receive a full refund to your original payment method.
If more than 24 hours have passed, cancel your ticket before departure to receive an eCredit for future travel.
Check your ticket type in 'My Trips' to confirm if it is refundable or non-refundable.
Review the expiration date and terms of your eCredit in your Delta account.
Contact Delta customer service if you believe you qualify for an exception (e.g., significant schedule change, medical emergency).
